text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I'm completely back on my feet!
I'll be in your care again starting today♪
choice_data_list: You seem to be in good condition.
You seem to be in good condition.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When you can rest, you must rest thoroughly!
Without pushing myself, I spent a relaxing time reading books and going on walks.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Also, I've been keeping a log of my meals and sleep,
so I can show you if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she managed herself thoroughly even during the break.
At this rate, our upcoming training will surely bear fruit.
